assumptions.statement: The team is currently in a development phase where rapid iteration is prioritized over external reusability.
assumptions.quote: Whilst developing a module we will source it locally (within this repository).

assumptions.statement: The modules are not yet considered stable or 'ready' for consumption by other teams or projects.
assumptions.quote: Once we feel our modules "ready" we will consider moving them to separate repositories.

assumptions.statement: The primary consumers of the modules are internal to the current repository/team, so the lack of external accessibility is acceptable.
assumptions.quote: Keeping modules locally will make them harder for others to use but make rapid iteration easier.
